name: Diamond Girl ~Koi no Maji Lesson~
original_name: ダイヤモンドガール～恋の本気レッスン～
source:
Proper ladies can do whatever they want!?"
You are a so-called "love-allergic" girl who spends
her time at home in a track suit.

You luckily get a job at the famous Misono Trading Company,
but it is discovered that you are actually
the heiress to the parent company's Misono family!?

You move into a mansion in order to learn how to be a proper lady,
but you just can't manage to get used to your glamorous lifestyle!

You continue to battle, surrounded by your kind butler,
hot and cold fiancé, and ditzy cousin!
translation:
“真正的女人可以为所欲为！？”
你是一个所谓“爱情过敏”的女孩
她在家里穿着运动服的时间。

你很幸运地在著名的Misono商社找到了一份工作，
但发现你其实是
母公司美园家族的继承人！？

你搬进豪宅是为了学习如何做一个得体的淑女，
但你就是无法适应你迷人的生活方式！

你继续战斗，身边有你善良的管家，
忽冷忽热的未婚夫，还有傻乎乎的表弟！
